thesis: Kim Liu argues that her due diligence process for Stefan Kaluzny was intentionally distant and critical, focusing on his lack of prior team management experience and his overconfidence rather than relying on their business school friendship. She further asserts that a re-underwriting is necessary because the retail landscape has changed significantly, requiring an assessment of whether Kaluzny's risk profile and market perspective have evolved since his past success.
